findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant validation before granting document access
findings.body: When `userTenant` differs from `documentTenant`, `canReadDocument` now still returns `true`. Any caller relying on this function for authorization can therefore permit cross-tenant document reads, violating the existing tenant-isolation contract.

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant validation before granting document access
findings.body:
`canReadDocument` now returns `true` for mismatched tenants (for example, `"tenant-a"` and `"tenant-b"`), eliminating the tenant isolation boundary and permitting cross-tenant document reads wherever this function guards access.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant isolation in document read authorization
findings.body:
`canReadDocument` now authorizes every request. Any user whose `userTenant` differs from the target `documentTenant` can pass this check and read another tenant’s documents, causing a cross-tenant authorization bypass.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._
